plain_statement.zh: 在原有的大弧截断、二进掩膜与模 30 模型下，证明模型修正项 Q 的绝对值对所有充分大偶数至多为 Cn/log² n。
plain_statement.en: Bound the absolute wheel-model correction Q by Cn/log² n for every sufficiently large even n, keeping the original arcs, mask and modulus-30 model.

brief.zh: WaterKing201030 在 #4136 给出线性下界，证伪原先要求 Q ≤ −n/312 的路线。本题若成立，可将模型修正吸收到任意固定的线性误差预算中。先用 #4128 的周期自相关隔离端点误差，再用 #4127 的掩膜估计控制短位移。将剩余周期项展开成模 30 的频率，估计各平移 Fejér 核在大弧以外的质量。尚需另外控制真正的素数相关项。
brief.en: PR #4136 refuted the old negative-linear target. Use the periodic autocorrelation in #4128 and mask bounds in #4127. Expand the triangular periodic term into shifted Fejér kernels and bound their tails outside the major arcs. This would absorb the model correction into any fixed linear budget. The prime correlation remains open.
